- GoToColor (B=8) moves toward colored OBJECTS in camera view - this means LED colors on other robots, not wall colors!
- Wall colors may not be detectable by GoToColor - only the camera condition (C=7) detects objects of a given color

- Robots can't directly "go to blue wall" using B=8 unless walls register as colored objects
